title: Senior SRE / Infrastructure Engineer (m/f/d)
description: Senior SRE / Infrastructure Engineer (m/f/d) Mission SimScale is a browser-based engineering simulation platform on AWS. Our infrastructure team builds and operates the shared cloud foundation that 40+ engineers across 10+ product teams rely on every day. We enable the product teams rather than acting as gatekeepers. Product teams own their services end-to-end, including their infrastructure code, monitoring, cloud cost and first response to incidents. We give them a safe and well-documented platform, guardrails and self-service tools. Thus the teams can do routine work themselves, also in production. You join this small team as a senior individual contributor. People management is not part of the role. As the team grows, a path to a technical lead role is possible. Your opportunity You will share these responsibilities with the rest of the infrastructure team: Keeping the platform simple and reliable across our AWS accounts and networks, the public edge, Kubernetes (EKS), the service mesh (Istio), and the GitOps pipelines Securing the platform against DDoS attacks, AI-assisted cyber-attacks, running bug-bounty programs Evolving our architecture to support dedicated, single-tenant deployments across regions and cloud providers Maintaining infrastructure as code in Terraform and ArgoCD, and making it easy and safe for all the teams Operating telemetry (metrics, logs, tracing) infrastructure, helping teams define SLOs and alerts, and measure their services Owning tools and processes for disaster recovery , including performing regular restore tests Building tools, patterns, and documentation with which other teams can provision, deploy and operate their services without the infrastructure team's direct involvement Helping to keep the petabyte-scale infrastructure cost-efficient Keeping up with the compliance requirements (such as SOC 2) Participating in the working hours support rotation , addressing incidents, helping other teams, finding and removing root causes of recurring problems On-call: the role has no on-call duty at this time. What we expect from you Proven experience at a senior level in SRE, platform or infrastructure engineering Hands-on infrastructure experience with a public cloud (AWS preferred), infrastructure as code (Terraform preferred), CI/CD and Kubernetes Strong skills in software engineering, in systems engineering, or in both . For example, you write production-quality code in Python or Go. Or you know Linux and distributed systems well enough to debug complex production problems Experience with observability, including metrics, logs, distributed tracing, and SLOs/SLIs You can investigate complex failures , communicate clearly during an incident, and change your findings into durable improvements You can explain trade-offs to engineers in other teams . You help them adopt better practices without unnecessary friction Bonus points: An open source portfolio or contributions Prior technical leadership experience, especially in infrastructure, reliability, or platform engineering Location: Remote (within CET ±5h). What you can expect from us Join a dedicated, supportive team with unlimited growth opportunities and leadership potential Make an impact quickly by sharing ideas and contributing to creative, goal-oriented projects Work in a diverse, inclusive environment with colleagues from over 35 countries Enjoy flexible hours and the freedom to work remotely from anywhere in the world Access comprehensive health coverage, retirement plans, paid time off, and wellness support Stay active with subsidized gym memberships, sports meetups, and wellness programs Grow as a professional with online/offline learning, language courses, and tech talks Connect at team events, join support groups, and contribute to our ESG and DE&I initiatives Participate in fun team challenges and competitions for added excitement and team spirit Diversity, Equity and Inclusion at SimScale At SimScale, we look beyond borders and hire great talent from all parts of the world. With our team consisting of people from various backgrounds, we truly embrace diversity and encourage everyone to be themselves. We are unified by curiosity, dedication and our team spirit! As an equal opportunity employer, we acknowledge that our employees have different aspirations and career goals, and therefore are committed to create a diverse environment. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status. A copy of SimScale's full recruiting guideline can be made available on request. Kindly let us know how you would like to be addressed and whether you have specific requirements for the interview.
